|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image. The later errata version is [[Lady Valarian (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.3 release sheet (official text as of 28 March 2013)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 8.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 28 March 2013"; the surviving copy was re-made 3 April 2013), page 2, slip 3 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Your total battle destiny here is +1. Unless Jabba on table, "Jabba" in the game text of your cards (except Hutt Bounty) may be treated as "Lady Valarian." Once per turn, may target a Mistryl of ability > 2 here; target gains Heroic until end of turn.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Lady_Valarian.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-ladyvalarian-pre.gif]]) print it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lady Valarian (Errata)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 11)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=11, page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> added Jabba's Prize to the exception and changed “target gains Heroic” to “target is Heroic”: “Your total battle destiny here is +1. Unless Jabba on table, "Jabba" in the game text of your cards (except Hutt Bounty and Jabba's Prize) may be treated as "Lady Valarian." Once per turn, may target a Mistryl of ability > 2 here; target is Heroic until end of turn.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1283-3-master.png]], marked “E”) prints it. The Players Committee announced this text on 13 April 2013, effective immediately, “to prevent an unintended interaction with Jabba's Prize” (the post misprints “treated at”)<ref name="pcforum-p802181">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 13 April 2013 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p802181 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
